### ANSAC PRODUCTS

### Dense Soda Ash

Manufacturers of quality flat glass, glass containers, lithium batteries and detergents rely on the
purity of ANSAC dense soda ash in making the world-class products their customers demand.

[Learn More][46]

### Medium Dense Soda Ash

Quality detergent manufacturers look to ANSAC medium dense soda ash as an attractive alternative to
ANSAC dense soda ash or synthetic light soda ash.

[Learn More][47]

### INTERNATIONAL NETWORK OF LOGISTICS SUPPORT

ANSAC is committed to providing international glassmakers, lithium battery producers, detergent
manufacturers, chemical processors and other users with quality natural soda ash when and where they
need it. We maintain a large international network of service representatives, agents and
distributors who are committed to delivering outstanding logistical support to our customers.

[Markets We Serve][48][Contact Us][49]

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

### Sulphur & Water Chemicals (SWC)

[READ MORE][91]

### Electrochemicals (EC)

[READ MORE][92]

## Product Applications

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

* [product application banner] *

### Industries we serve include:

Water and Wastewater Treatment, Food, Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Oil & Gas, Industrial Processing,
Agriculture, and more.

[Read More][93]

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

### Sulphur & Water Chemicals (SWC)

## Product Applications

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

* [product application banner] *

### Industries we serve include:

Water and Wastewater Treatment, Food, Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Oil & Gas, Industrial Processing,
Agriculture, and more.

[Read More][93]

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

Roseville MN, 55113

Get to know Lhoist

## At Lhoist, we provide lime, dolime, and mineral-based solutions that drive progress worldwide.

We partner with our customers and we deliver critical solutions across various [industries][5]. From
treating [drinking water][6] and [stabilizing soils][7] to [reducing emissions][8] and supporting
demanding industrial processes, our [products][9] support demanding operations that must perform
consistently.

Learn more about us
][10]

## Partner with Lhoist

We combine deep operational [expertise][11] with dependable, high‑performing solutions that perform
where it matters - in the real‑world conditions our customers face every day. Our products are
engineered to meet the specific demands of critical operations and applications. Beyond supply, we
also provide hands‑on [technical support][12] and reliable logistics services to help optimize
performance and efficiency.

Explore our solutions
][13]

Our [lime][17], [dolime][18], and mineral solutions enable clean [water][19], stable soils,
[steel][20] under pressure, and renewable energy - where reliability matters every single day. 
Founded in 1889 and still family-owned, we combine long-term vision with hands-on expertise to meet
evolving needs. 
With 6,400+ people across 20+ countries, 130+ sites, and 80+ country sales reach, we stay close to
customers to secure supply and ensure continuity when it counts. 
Guided by respect, integrity, and courage, we work on site with operators, anticipating issues,
adapting to conditions, and creating lasting value through strong partnerships. Our teams deliver
the insight and support that keep performance steady and consistently.

# Zero In

Oxy is taking bold steps to innovate for a lower-carbon future. We’re forging new pathways to reduce
emissions across our oil and gas operations while providing products and services to help others do
the same, with the ambition of achieving net zero.

Learn more about how we Zero In® [2025 Climate Report][66]

# Producing vital energy to sustain people and our planet

We continuously enhance our operations to deliver the energy that lifts up societies and economies
around the world, while innovating new approaches to advance global sustainability.

[Explore Oxy Performance Production][67] [2025 Sustainability Report][68]

# Advancing a low-carbon future

We advance visionary technologies that accelerate global emissions reduction in our own operations
and other industries, including a first-of-its-kind Direct Air Capture facility in the Permian
Basin.

Watch: Leading the Way [Explore Oxy Carbon Innovation][69]

### Expanding Opportunity for the Benefit of Society

We are taking action to achieve diversity, inclusion and belonging (DIB) within our workforce, with
the goal of recruiting and retaining top talent and improving lives and expanding opportunities in
the communities where we operate.

[Our DIB Commitment][72]

Across our operations, we connect. We progress. We innovate. We Zero In.

### Performance Production

### Performance Production

For more than a century, our high-performing teams have driven advancements in the production of
energy. Today we’re applying our culture of innovation to help solve our planet’s most pressing
environmental challenges. We have built safe, efficient operations that harness the power of
large-scale CO2 storage technology to drive our enhanced oil recovery (EOR) programs. At the same
time, we're taking concrete steps on the ground to reduce our emissions.

[Explore Performance Production][73]

### Carbon Innovation

### Carbon Innovation

As we take bold steps to reduce emissions across every facet of our business, we’re creating the
future. Utilizing our robust CO2 management infrastructure, we are accelerating carbon capture,
utilization and storage (CCUS), direct air capture and other visionary technologies to decarbonize
our operations and help other industries do the same.

 

[Explore Carbon Innovation][74]

## Climate

Our Climate Report summarizes Oxy’s Net-Zero Strategy to apply our experience in the capture,
transportation, utilization and sequestration of CO2 in order to develop and commercialize
technologies that lower GHG emissions and remove CO2 from the atmosphere to help advance our
net-zero goals and create long-term shareholder value.

[2025 Oxy Climate Report][78]

We also provide information via our [Climate Policy Positions][79] and [Climate Advocacy and
Engagement][80] documents.

[ Learn More ][81] [ 2025 Climate Report Executive Summary ][82]

## Sustainability

Learn more about our ongoing evaluation of ways in which we can integrate sustainability throughout
the company, improve our programs and performance, and transparently share our progress with
stakeholders in our 2025 Sustainability Report.

[2025 Oxy Sustainability Report][83]
[ Learn More ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Report Executive Summary ][85]
[Three employees walking along solar panels at GoldSmith facility]

### Build the world’s future
### while building yours

At Oxy we’re leading the way to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future through carbon capture and
other leading-edge technologies. To get there, we’ll need big thinkers with big ambitions for their
careers, our company, our industry and our planet. Sound like you? Join us.

[Explore Careers][86]

## Mileposts on our journey to net zero

### Direct Air Capture: Groundbreaking technology in the Permian

Construction is underway for our first Direct Air Capture (DAC) plant, STRATOS, in the Permian
Basin. When construction is complete, it will be the largest facility of its kind in the world. Oxy
formed 1PointFive, a development company, to finance and deploy Carbon Engineering's large-scale DAC
technology for this groundbreaking project.

### Goldsmith: Powering our field operations with solar to reduce carbon intensity

In 2019, Oxy completed construction of its Goldsmith Solar Plant: a 16 MW photovoltaic solar field
with the distinction of being Texas’ first large-scale solar facility powering oil and gas
operations. Today the 174,000-panel solar farm directly powers our EOR operations in the Goldsmith,
Texas area and reduces indirect energy use GHG emissions (Scope 2) in our operations by reducing the
need for consumption of grid power.

### Cemvita Factory: Giving CO₂ a greater purpose and in turn reducing emissions

Oxy is partnering with Cemvita Factory to develop advanced chemistry that will prevent CO2 from
being emitted by using it as a feedstock for sustainable production of vital chemicals and polymers.
Once constructed, the pilot plant will employ an alternate bio-ethylene production process that uses
only CO2, water and light, greatly reducing manufacturing costs and carbon emissions.

# Zero In

Oxy is taking bold steps to innovate for a lower-carbon future. We’re forging new pathways to reduce
emissions across our oil and gas operations while providing products and services to help others do
the same, with the ambition of achieving net zero.

Learn more about how we Zero In® [2025 Climate Report][66]

# Producing vital energy to sustain people and our planet

We continuously enhance our operations to deliver the energy that lifts up societies and economies
around the world, while innovating new approaches to advance global sustainability.

[Explore Oxy Performance Production][67] [2025 Sustainability Report][68]

# Advancing a low-carbon future

We advance visionary technologies that accelerate global emissions reduction in our own operations
and other industries, including a first-of-its-kind Direct Air Capture facility in the Permian
Basin.

Watch: Leading the Way [Explore Oxy Carbon Innovation][69]

### Expanding Opportunity for the Benefit of Society

We are taking action to achieve diversity, inclusion and belonging (DIB) within our workforce, with
the goal of recruiting and retaining top talent and improving lives and expanding opportunities in
the communities where we operate.

[Our DIB Commitment][72]

Across our operations, we connect. We progress. We innovate. We Zero In.

### Performance Production

energy. Today we’re applying our culture of innovation to help solve our planet’s most pressing
environmental challenges. We have built safe, efficient operations that harness the power of
large-scale CO2 storage technology to drive our enhanced oil recovery (EOR) programs. At the same
time, we're taking concrete steps on the ground to reduce our emissions.

[Explore Performance Production][73]

## Climate

Our Climate Report summarizes Oxy’s Net-Zero Strategy to apply our experience in the capture,
transportation, utilization and sequestration of CO2 in order to develop and commercialize
technologies that lower GHG emissions and remove CO2 from the atmosphere to help advance our
net-zero goals and create long-term shareholder value.

[2025 Oxy Climate Report][78]

We also provide information via our [Climate Policy Positions][79] and [Climate Advocacy and
Engagement][80] documents.

[ Learn More ][81] [ 2025 Climate Report Executive Summary ][82]

## Sustainability

Learn more about our ongoing evaluation of ways in which we can integrate sustainability throughout
the company, improve our programs and performance, and transparently share our progress with
stakeholders in our 2025 Sustainability Report.

### Build the world’s future
### while building yours

At Oxy we’re leading the way to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future through carbon capture and
other leading-edge technologies. To get there, we’ll need big thinkers with big ambitions for their
careers, our company, our industry and our planet. Sound like you? Join us.

[Explore Careers][86]

## Mileposts on our journey to net zero

### Direct Air Capture: Groundbreaking technology in the Permian

Construction is underway for our first Direct Air Capture (DAC) plant, STRATOS, in the Permian
Basin. When construction is complete, it will be the largest facility of its kind in the world. Oxy
formed 1PointFive, a development company, to finance and deploy Carbon Engineering's large-scale DAC
technology for this groundbreaking project.

### Goldsmith: Powering our field operations with solar to reduce carbon intensity

In 2019, Oxy completed construction of its Goldsmith Solar Plant: a 16 MW photovoltaic solar field
with the distinction of being Texas’ first large-scale solar facility powering oil and gas
operations. Today the 174,000-panel solar farm directly powers our EOR operations in the Goldsmith,
Texas area and reduces indirect energy use GHG emissions (Scope 2) in our operations by reducing the
need for consumption of grid power.

### Cemvita Factory: Giving CO₂ a greater purpose and in turn reducing emissions

Oxy is partnering with Cemvita Factory to develop advanced chemistry that will prevent CO2 from
being emitted by using it as a feedstock for sustainable production of vital chemicals and polymers.
Once constructed, the pilot plant will employ an alternate bio-ethylene production process that uses
only CO2, water and light, greatly reducing manufacturing costs and carbon emissions.

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

# BASEKIM Leading Manufacturer and Exporter of Bitumen and Industrial Chemicals

BASEKIM Chemical Production is producer and exporter of high quality and competitive price with
various types and grades including bituminous production grade **[bitumen 60/70][356]** and 80/100
bitumen 115/15 MC for road construction, paving and isolation, insulation well drilling mud chemical
including Gilsonite natural asphalt powder 200 mesh for fluid loss control and cementing, caustic
soda flakes, calcium chloride, polyanionic cellulose, starch, sulphonated asphalt, CMC, LABSA
TEXAPON SLES sulfonic acid plus export of paraffin wax in light and heavy grades also fully refined
and semi refined.We export fully refined and semi refined candle wax petroleum jelly vaseline for
cosmetic, medical usage along with rubber process oil high and low viscosity and carbon black N330
N600.

[[OIL WELL DRILLING MUD]][357]

## [OIL WELL DRILLING MUD][358]
* gilsonite (natural asphalt, gilsonit)
* CMC (carboxymethyl cellulose)
* PAC (polyanionic cellulose)
* Starch
* Sulphonated asphalt
* Calcium chloride
* LABSA (linear alkyl benzene sulfonate) Sulfonic acid
* SLS (Sodium Lauryl Sulfate)
* SLES (Sodium lauryl ether sulfate)TEXAPON
* Casutic soda (sodium hydroxide)

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

# About GHCL Limited

Incorporated in 1983, GHCL is India’s largest soda ash manufacturer at a single location. Our
portfolio includes Dense Soda Ash, Light Soda Ash, and Sodium Bicarbonate, manufactured with
precision and consistent quality standards.

GHCL powers several key Indian industries, including glass, ceramics, detergents, baking powder,
solar panels, and lithium-ion batteries supporting the nation’s infrastructure growth and EV
ecosystem. Backed by captive raw material resources and our trusted brand ‘LION’, we are committed
to strengthening India’s industrial self-reliance while enabling a greener and more sustainable
future.

# Sustainability

At GHCL, sustainability is embedded in our long-term vision and operational strategy. We are
advancing cleaner and more efficient manufacturing through continuous investments in sustainable
technologies, carbon reduction initiatives, and process optimization. By integrating innovation with
environmental responsibility, we aim to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 30% by 2030, while
contributing towards a more sustainable industrial future for India.

# Sustainability

At GHCL, sustainability is embedded in our long-term vision and operational strategy. We are
advancing cleaner and more efficient manufacturing through continuous investments in sustainable
technologies, carbon reduction initiatives, and process optimization. By integrating innovation with
environmental responsibility, we aim to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 30% by 2030, while
contributing towards a more sustainable industrial future for India.

# Humens formule et fabrique des produits d’origine minérale et d’une grande pureté

Acteur incontournable sur ce segment, nous fournissons les industriels du monde entier.
[Découvrir le groupe][66]

### Nos produits

**Nous sommes des fabricants de pureté depuis 170 ans.
**
Depuis la création de nos activités de chimie minérale en 1855, nous ambitionnons de fournir à nos
clients des produits d’un niveau de pureté maximal, en veillant à limiter toujours plus nos impacts
environnementaux.

[Découvrir notre savoir-faire][67]

### Nos engagements

La feuille de route stratégique de Humens sert quatre objectifs : limiter drastiquement les impacts
de son activité sur le climat et l’environnement, garantir la sécurité, la qualité et la conformité
de ses produits et services, créer de la valeur durable et oeuvrer pour le bien-être et le respect
des individus.

### Notre actualité

# Humens formule et fabrique des produits d’origine minérale et d’une grande pureté

Acteur incontournable sur ce segment, nous fournissons les industriels du monde entier.
[Découvrir le groupe][66]

### Nos produits

**Nous sommes des fabricants de pureté depuis 170 ans.
**
Depuis la création de nos activités de chimie minérale en 1855, nous ambitionnons de fournir à nos
clients des produits d’un niveau de pureté maximal, en veillant à limiter toujours plus nos impacts
environnementaux.

[Découvrir notre savoir-faire][67]

### Nos engagements

La feuille de route stratégique de Humens sert quatre objectifs : limiter drastiquement les impacts
de son activité sur le climat et l’environnement, garantir la sécurité, la qualité et la conformité
de ses produits et services, créer de la valeur durable et oeuvrer pour le bien-être et le respect
des individus.

**Nous sommes des fabricants de pureté depuis 170 ans.

  At Interstate Chemical, every solution starts with the client. We take the time to understand your
  operation, your challenges, and your goals. Whether it’s sourcing essential chemicals, blending to
  your exact specifications, or providing environmentally responsible services, our focus is always
  on delivering what your business needs to succeed.
* ### **Reliable Supply, Trusted Service**
  
  Your business depends on consistency — and that’s exactly what Interstate Chemical provides. From
  our Florida hub, we manage chemical distribution with precision and care, ensuring you have
  uninterrupted access to the products you rely on. Our dedicated team is always just a call away,
  ready to respond with the right answers and the right solutions.
* ### **Partnership Beyond Products**
  
  We don’t just deliver chemicals; we deliver confidence. Interstate Chemical builds long-term
  partnerships by focusing on service, safety, and sustainability. By putting clients first, we
  create value far beyond the product itself — giving you a trusted partner who works alongside you
  to strengthen your supply chain and protect your business for the future.

## OUR COMPANY

Ishtar is a subsidiary to a bigger holding group, **[Barus Holding Group][98]**, founded in 2007.
This group deals in supplying and trading of different kinds of [**Petroleum Products**][99],
Petrochemicals and Minerals. This Group has over 10 years of brilliant background in the field of
international trade and is fully operative in Europe and Asia. Ishtar is one of the major activists
in the area by exporting different commodities to countries such as Spain, Germany, Netherlands,
Russia, China, India, countries of the CIS, Iraq, Pakistan, Oman, Qatar and UAE, **[This

# Küresel Pazarlara
# TurkExim ile Açılın

Dünya genelinde **39'dan fazla stratejik ülkeden** gerçek ithalatçı ve ihracatçı konşimento (Bill of
Lading) verilerine ulaşın. Rakiplerinizi analiz edin, yeni pazarlar keşfedin ve ticaret hacminizi
genişletin.

[ Veritabanını İncele ][25] [ Üyelik Paketlerini Gör ][26]
39+ Ülke Resmi Gümrük Beyan Verisi
%100 Gerçek Konşimento Kanıtları ve Sevkiyatlar
Kesintisiz 7/24 Erişim ve Güncel Veri Akışı

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

## Canlı Veri Arama Deneyimi

GTİP veya Ürün Adı girerek küresel veri tabanımızın nasıl çalıştığını simüle edin.

Sorgula

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Güncel Duyurular ve Veritabanı

Gümrük ağımızı sürekli genişletiyor ve ihracata giden yolları kısaltıyoruz.

[ Tüm Duyurular → ][29]
YENI VERI SETI

### 8 Yeni Ülkenin Resmi Verileri Entegre Edildi

Küresel erişiminizi artırmak için gümrük ağı veri setlerimize şu stratejik pazarları da ekledik:
* ABD
* Ekvador
* Pakistan
* Uruguay
* Etiyopya
* Paraguay
* Panama
* Vietnam

### Bulut Altyapı Performans Güncellemesi

Veritabanı sorgu motorlarımızda gerçekleştirdiğimiz SQL ve NoSQL optimizasyonları sayesinde,
karmaşık GTİP ve çoklu ülke konşimento aramalarınız artık 3 kat daha hızlı yanıt veriyor.

Yayınlanma Tarihi: Yakın zamanda

Natrium Products is a leading manufacturer of specialty sodium bicarbonate for the North American
market. Natrium manufactures and distributes standard and specialty grade sodium bicarbonate/baking
soda in package and bulk.

Tell us about your application! We strive to learn about your unique needs enabling us to provide
precise product recommendations and product delivery.

[Learn More][23]

## [Natrium for Soda Blasting][24]

Natrium sodium bicarbonate is ideal for soda blasting. Less dusty and more productive than
competitive products due to it’s granulation type, our material cleans a variety of contaminants for
a number of industries and trades.

[Learn More][25]

## [Natrium for Special Applications][26]

Natrium Sodium Bicarbonate can be used for a number of different applications including as tablets,
for re-packaging, for blending or compounding, and much more.

[Learn More][27]

## Natrium Products offers Standard & Specialty Grades

We love working with customers to find the right product for their application. Contact us and talk
with our experienced sales team about your sodium bicarbonate or [soda ash][28] needs.

Our soda blast media formulations are **LESS dusty, and MORE productive**. Available in 50 lb bags
and 2,300lb sacks, with one formula – Natrium 260 – also available in 25 lb bags.

[Explore Specialty Grades][29]

## Customized Solutions

Unlike “big box” sodium-bicarbonate suppliers, we know a one-size fits all approach to products and
services isn’t effective. Customers come to us with distinct, unique problems they need solved and
WE develop solutions!

[Read our Success Story][30]

## Natrium Products Serves Many Industries

Our sodium bicarbonate can be found in many industries. From water treatment to pharmaceuticals, our
products are vital.

[Who Uses Natrium?][31]

Looking for a more sustainable option for sodium bicarbonate bags? Natrium Products has made that
possible with our “repulpable” paper bags.

## Fueling the Future

# Ohana Chem Co.

Ohana Chem Co. is a national chemical distributor delivering ultra-high-purity solvents with
uncompromising quality and reliability. From ethanol and heptane to a full suite of specialty
solvents, we serve industries ranging from botanical extraction to pharmaceuticals, food processing,
and manufacturing. Backed by partnerships with leaders like Marquis Energy, we combine scale,
sustainability, and service to keep your operations moving. Quality in, Quality Out.
[ Learn More ][27]

Your Trusted Partner in High-Purity Solvents and Chemical Solutions.

## About Ohana Chem Co.

Ohana Chem Co. isn’t just another distributor – we set the standard others aim to match.

We began by transforming the botanical extraction industry, delivering ultra-high-purity solvents on
time, every time, and backing them with service that raised the bar for efficiency and quality. From
that foundation, we expanded far beyond botanical. Today, our reach extends across industries where
solvents drive production – pharmaceuticals, food processing, specialty chemicals, manufacturing,
and beyond.

Our portfolio is built for serious operators: 200 proof ethanol, PureMax™ Ultra-High-Purity CDA-12A,
PureMax™ Ultra-High-Purity Heptane, plus a full suite of carefully sourced solvents distributed with
zero compromise. Every order comes with more than just product – it comes with reliability,
technical support, and the confidence of working with a trusted partner.

What sets us apart? Relentless commitment. Quality is never compromised. Service isn’t negotiable.
And sustainability isn’t a buzzword – it’s built into how we do business. Our partnership with

    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.

    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.

cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage

    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
    customers.
    
    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support
    to deliver what we promise when we promise.
  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.
  * [Compliance][92]
    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.
    
    Implementation of the required control systems enable us to meet all regulatory compliance and
    legislation, ensuring the chemicals and services we provide to you achieve consistent standards
    and exceed your expectations.

# Industrial chemical supplies and services for the UK and Ireland

### DISCOVER PLATER

[plater mini logo]

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and
contract packaging. This integrated approach allows us to deliver consistent, compliant and
cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

[Tianjin Soda Plant]
June 5, 2026

#### Tianjin Soda Plant

As the birthplace of China’s modern chemical industry and one of Asia’s earliest large-scale soda
ash producers, Tianjin Soda Plant (with Tianjin Bohua Yongli Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. as its core
operating entity) was founded in 1917. Over more than a century of evolution, it has not only
witnessed the full journey of China’s national chemical industry—from scratch, from catching up to
global leadership—but also completed a critical transition from a single soda production factory to
a modern chemical industry cluster amid the wave of industrial upgrading and green transformation,
standing as a typical example of high-quality development for traditional chemical enterprises in
China.Industrial Patriotism: The Starting Point of China’s Soda Industry Breaking Western
MonopolyThe history of Tianjin Soda Plant is a chronicle of self-reliance and technological
advancement in China’s chemical sector. Its predecessor can be traced back to Jiuda Refined Salt
Factory, established in Tanggu, Tianjin in 1914 by patriotic industrialist Fan Xudong. In 1917,
Yongli Soda Ash Company was formally founded as China’s first private soda ash manufacturer.At that
time, China’s soda ash market was completely monopolized by Britain’s Brunner Mond Company. During
World War I, disrupted Eurasian shipping sent imported soda prices surging severalfold, triggering
widespread shutdowns among domestic downstream enterprises in dyeing, glassmaking, food processing
and other sectors. Against this backdrop, Fan Xudong, alongside chemical industry pioneer Chen
Tiaofu and other partners, resolved to manufacture soda from local salt. He recruited US-educated
chemical engineer Hou Debang to return to China as chief engineer, launching independent research
into domestic soda production technology.After six years of iterative experiments, Hou Debang’s team
successfully unlocked the core technology of the Solvay (ammonia-soda) process, which had been
strictly blockaded by Western powers. In 1926, "Red Triangle" brand soda ash, with a purity
exceeding 99%, achieved stable mass production. That same year, it won the gold medal at the 1926
Philadelphia Sesquicentennial Exposition, hailed by the organizing committee as "a symbol of China’s
industrial progress", and completely broke the decades-long Western technological and market
monopoly over the soda ash industry. In 1930, the product claimed another gold medal at the Belgian
Industrial and Commercial Exposition, marking the first time a Chinese chemical product reached
world-class standards.Following the full outbreak of the War of Resistance against Japanese
Aggression, the factory’s core technical team relocated westward to Wutongqiao, Sichuan, carrying
technical drawings and equipment to build a new production base named "New Tanggu". Confronted with
the high cost of inland well salt and soaring raw material expenses, Hou Debang’s team spent years
conducting over 500 cyclic trials. In 1941, they successfully invented the Hou’s Combined Soda
Process (later officially named the combined soda process).This technology deeply integrates
synthetic ammonia production with soda ash manufacturing, lifting salt utilization from 70% (under
the Solvay process) to over 96%, cutting production costs by 40%, and converting soda-making waste
liquor into agricultural ammonium chloride fertilizer. It fundamentally solved the industry-wide
problem of waste residue and liquid pollution from traditional ammonia-soda production. In 1953, the
technology was awarded No. 1 Invention Certificate of the People’s Republic of China, and it remains
one of the world’s mainstream soda ash production processes to this day.As the core entity of the
historic "Yongjiu-Huang" alliance (Yongli Soda Plant, Jiuda Refined Salt, Huanghai Chemical Industry
Research Society), Tianjin Soda Plant is recognized alongside Nankai University and Ta Kung Pao as
one of the "Three Treasures of Tianjin", and stands as a key cultural symbol of the spirit of
China’s modern national industry.Industrial Iteration: Building a Modern Chemical System Integrating
Three Major SectorsAfter the founding of the People’s Republic of China, Tianjin Soda Plant
underwent public-private partnership restructuring and industry consolidation. Today it is a core
backbone enterprise under Tianjin Bohai Chemical Industry Group Co., Ltd. It completed corporate
system reform in 2013 and was officially renamed Tianjin Bohua Yongli Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.To
align with urban functional upgrading and industrial restructuring, Tianjin Soda Plant launched its
relocation and modernization project in 2005, constructing a 2-square-kilometer new production base
in Lingang Economic Zone, Tianjin Binhai New Area, which went fully operational at the end of 2010.
Led by advanced coal gasification facilities, the new site has established a diversified industrial
landscape with coordinated development of marine chemicals, coal chemicals and petrochemicals,
entirely moving beyond its traditional identity as a single-product soda ash factory:Traditional
advantage segment: It operates an 800,000 t/a combined soda production unit. Its "Red Triangle" soda
ash and "Neptune" agricultural ammonium chloride have both been named "China Famous Brand Products",
maintaining enduring brand competitiveness in domestic markets and overseas markets across Southeast
Asia and Africa.Extended industrial chain: It has built production capacity for over ten product
lines, including 300,000 t/a synthetic ammonia, 500,000 t/a methanol, 500,000 t/a butyl octanol,
350,000 t/a acetic acid, 40,000 t/a polyoxymethylene (POM) and 150,000 t/a food-grade liquid carbon
dioxide, covering basic chemical raw materials, fine chemicals, food additives, polymer materials
and other application fields.Industrial ecosystem support: It hosts a complete utility system
including air separation, on-site thermal power and wastewater treatment. Leveraging its
geographical proximity to Tianjin Port and the Tianjin Pilot Free Trade Zone, it realizes
port-chemical integrated logistics coordination, forming full-chain operational capabilities
spanning manufacturing, international trade, logistics warehousing and technical services.To date,
the company has filed over 300 patents, including 145 invention patents. It is a national high-tech
enterprise, and has been inscribed on the "China Time-honored Brands" list and the ranking of
China’s Top 500 Petroleum and Chemical Enterprises.Green Transformation: High-Quality Development
Anchored on Dual Carbon GoalsIn recent years, amid the global low-carbon transition of the chemical
industry, Tianjin Soda Plant has built on its century-long technical heritage to make green and
low-carbon development a core strategy, advancing in-depth upgrades in energy conservation, carbon
reduction, circular economy and new energy deployment.On the production side, the company continues
to reduce unit product energy and material consumption through full-process process optimization and
intelligent equipment upgrading. Through industrial flue gas purification and recovery technology,
it captures carbon dioxide generated during production and processes it into food-grade liquid
carbon dioxide products, realizing resourceful, high-value utilization of carbon emissions and
forming a model circular economy system.On energy structure

[Tianjin Soda Plant]
June 5, 2026

#### Tianjin Soda Plant

As the birthplace of China’s modern chemical industry and one of Asia’s earliest large-scale soda
ash producers, Tianjin Soda Plant (with Tianjin Bohua Yongli Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. as its core
operating entity) was founded in 1917. Over more than a century of evolution, it has not only
witnessed the full journey of China’s national chemical industry—from scratch, from catching up to
global leadership—but also completed a critical transition from a single soda production factory to
a modern chemical industry cluster amid the wave of industrial upgrading and green transformation,
standing as a typical example of high-quality development for traditional chemical enterprises in
China.Industrial Patriotism: The Starting Point of China’s Soda Industry Breaking Western
MonopolyThe history of Tianjin Soda Plant is a chronicle of self-reliance and technological
advancement in China’s chemical sector. Its predecessor can be traced back to Jiuda Refined Salt
Factory, established in Tanggu, Tianjin in 1914 by patriotic industrialist Fan Xudong. In 1917,
Yongli Soda Ash Company was formally founded as China’s first private soda ash manufacturer.At that
time, China’s soda ash market was completely monopolized by Britain’s Brunner Mond Company. During
World War I, disrupted Eurasian shipping sent imported soda prices surging severalfold, triggering
widespread shutdowns among domestic downstream enterprises in dyeing, glassmaking, food processing
and other sectors. Against this backdrop, Fan Xudong, alongside chemical industry pioneer Chen
Tiaofu and other partners, resolved to manufacture soda from local salt. He recruited US-educated
chemical engineer Hou Debang to return to China as chief engineer, launching independent research
into domestic soda production technology.After six years of iterative experiments, Hou Debang’s team
successfully unlocked the core technology of the Solvay (ammonia-soda) process, which had been
strictly blockaded by Western powers. In 1926, "Red Triangle" brand soda ash, with a purity
exceeding 99%, achieved stable mass production. That same year, it won the gold medal at the 1926
Philadelphia Sesquicentennial Exposition, hailed by the organizing committee as "a symbol of China’s
industrial progress", and completely broke the decades-long Western technological and market
monopoly over the soda ash industry. In 1930, the product claimed another gold medal at the Belgian
Industrial and Commercial Exposition, marking the first time a Chinese chemical product reached
world-class standards.Following the full outbreak of the War of Resistance against Japanese
Aggression, the factory’s core technical team relocated westward to Wutongqiao, Sichuan, carrying
technical drawings and equipment to build a new production base named "New Tanggu". Confronted with
the high cost of inland well salt and soaring raw material expenses, Hou Debang’s team spent years
conducting over 500 cyclic trials. In 1941, they successfully invented the Hou’s Combined Soda
Process (later officially named the combined soda process).This technology deeply integrates
synthetic ammonia production with soda ash manufacturing, lifting salt utilization from 70% (under
the Solvay process) to over 96%, cutting production costs by 40%, and converting soda-making waste
liquor into agricultural ammonium chloride fertilizer. It fundamentally solved the industry-wide
problem of waste residue and liquid pollution from traditional ammonia-soda production. In 1953, the
technology was awarded No. 1 Invention Certificate of the People’s Republic of China, and it remains
one of the world’s mainstream soda ash production processes to this day.As the core entity of the
historic "Yongjiu-Huang" alliance (Yongli Soda Plant, Jiuda Refined Salt, Huanghai Chemical Industry
Research Society), Tianjin Soda Plant is recognized alongside Nankai University and Ta Kung Pao as
one of the "Three Treasures of Tianjin", and stands as a key cultural symbol of the spirit of
China’s modern national industry.Industrial Iteration: Building a Modern Chemical System Integrating
Three Major SectorsAfter the founding of the People’s Republic of China, Tianjin Soda Plant
underwent public-private partnership restructuring and industry consolidation. Today it is a core
backbone enterprise under Tianjin Bohai Chemical Industry Group Co., Ltd. It completed corporate
system reform in 2013 and was officially renamed Tianjin Bohua Yongli Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.To
align with urban functional upgrading and industrial restructuring, Tianjin Soda Plant launched its
relocation and modernization project in 2005, constructing a 2-square-kilometer new production base
in Lingang Economic Zone, Tianjin Binhai New Area, which went fully operational at the end of 2010.
Led by advanced coal gasification facilities, the new site has established a diversified industrial
landscape with coordinated development of marine chemicals, coal chemicals and petrochemicals,
entirely moving beyond its traditional identity as a single-product soda ash factory:Traditional
advantage segment: It operates an 800,000 t/a combined soda production unit. Its "Red Triangle" soda
ash and "Neptune" agricultural ammonium chloride have both been named "China Famous Brand Products",
maintaining enduring brand competitiveness in domestic markets and overseas markets across Southeast
Asia and Africa.Extended industrial chain: It has built production capacity for over ten product
lines, including 300,000 t/a synthetic ammonia, 500,000 t/a methanol, 500,000 t/a butyl octanol,
350,000 t/a acetic acid, 40,000 t/a polyoxymethylene (POM) and 150,000 t/a food-grade liquid carbon
dioxide, covering basic chemical raw materials, fine chemicals, food additives, polymer materials
and other application fields.Industrial ecosystem support: It hosts a complete utility system
including air separation, on-site thermal power and wastewater treatment. Leveraging its
geographical proximity to Tianjin Port and the Tianjin Pilot Free Trade Zone, it realizes
port-chemical integrated logistics coordination, forming full-chain operational capabilities
spanning manufacturing, international trade, logistics warehousing and technical services.To date,
the company has filed over 300 patents, including 145 invention patents. It is a national high-tech
enterprise, and has been inscribed on the "China Time-honored Brands" list and the ranking of
China’s Top 500 Petroleum and Chemical Enterprises.Green Transformation: High-Quality Development
Anchored on Dual Carbon GoalsIn recent years, amid the global low-carbon transition of the chemical
industry, Tianjin Soda Plant has built on its century-long technical heritage to make green and
low-carbon development a core strategy, advancing in-depth upgrades in energy conservation, carbon
reduction, circular economy and new energy deployment.On the production side, the company continues
to reduce unit product energy and material consumption through full-process process optimization and
intelligent equipment upgrading. Through industrial flue gas purification and recovery technology,
it captures carbon dioxide generated during production and processes it into food-grade liquid
carbon dioxide products, realizing resourceful, high-value utilization of carbon emissions and

chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

## About Vinipul

**“ISO 9001:2015 & 14001:2015 Certified Company”**
Since our inception we have become the manufacturer, supplier and exporter of a wide range of
Inorganic and Industrial chemicals. Our products are used extensively across a wide range of
industries.

We are equipped with a modern production line which has all the necessary equipment to ensure round
the clock production. Our staffs are well trained and strictly adhere to the set industrial norms
and safety regulations. The effort we put in providing the best quality products and the positive
feedback received from our esteemed customers has enabled us in realizing our dream of expanding our
business in the European and United States markets.

[ Read More ][276]

## What We Provide

## Industries We Serve

We have successfully been catering to the needs of the industries Like Pharmaceutical, Chemical,
Drug etc..

## Infrastructure

We are equipped with a state of the art production line, which is of a suitable area to ensure round
the clock production.

## Research and Development

Owing a well equipped R&D unit, we have been able to stay in regular touch with the latest changes
of the market and technology.

## Team of Experts

Backed up with a team of diligent professional, we have been able to formulate world class
formulations that provide maximum customer satisfaction.

## Quality

We offer superior quality products to our clients. Our company has a team of experts to check the
quality of the products.

## Customer Satisfaction

Customer oriented philosophy have enabled us to earn immense accolade in the domestic as well as
international market.

## Our Product Range

We offer a wide range of industrial chemicals to meet the specific requirements of our clients
spread across the country. These can be availed from us in qualitative packaging assuring their
quality till the time these reach at the final destination. We offer our range at cost-effective
prices.

Inorganic and Industrial chemicals. Our products are used extensively across a wide range of
industries.

the clock production. Our staffs are well trained and strictly adhere to the set industrial norms
and safety regulations. The effort we put in providing the best quality products and the positive
